reviews.title: Ripped off
reviews.text: Would give it minus five stars if possible. Cancelled the trial after 7 days and still got billed, not worth anything without mobile coverage, so useless out to sea or offshore.

reviews.title: No good.
reviews.text: This app is a waste of money. Glitches and missing very important navigation markers. It was lucky I know the area I was in because the app didn’t have this danger area marked. If I hit it major damage and loss of life could have happened. Do not get this app.

reviews.title: A lot of work left to do
reviews.text: Auto routing takes me across land. A lot of work left to do to make this usable and preferred. At $10 less than Navionics, too expensive for what it offers right now. Keep improving, and incorporate an anchor alarm. That is one thing Navionics doesn’t have.

reviews.title: Garbage do not buy
reviews.text: Does not work at all , total waste of money

reviews.title: Bait and switch
reviews.text: Says you have maps then wants a subscription. Hell I’ll go buy me a TP for that paying that every year.

reviews.title: Provide some type option for free
reviews.text:
Couldn’t tell you what the app offers. Obviously you give your email and name before they tell you anything. Once you create a simple profile, pay wall. X out, restart… same paywall. X out, log back in paywall. 

Like no offense I understand the idea a company needs profits but i don’t and know one else knows what the app helps with doing. Let me just pay 70 buck to find out like no! Fix your philosophy, make it free then ask for money like every other app.

reviews.title: Lake Vermilion in Mn.
reviews.text: No nautical data for one of Minnesota’s  largest lakes!  Of course I don’t find that out until I’ve paid for a subscription.

reviews.title: Not free
reviews.text: Thought it would be like Waze but no it’s not free and I don’t need it enough to pay.

reviews.title: Not Useful in Northern Ontario
reviews.text: The map is not topical, the same map as google satellite. Shallows totally missing for Lake Huron. Also lost $12 after using the app for 2h because cancelling is for next month. Couldn’t use without signing up.

reviews.title: Forced subscription before trying
reviews.text: Sucks all apps force you to agree to subscription rather then providing you with an actual free trial like this one I was gonna give it a try but not anymore

reviews.title: no information on big lakes near me.
reviews.text: i wanted to go out on a few lakes near me but it literally says no information. but showes me everything about other lakes 200 miles away. waste of money for this app

reviews.title: No lake data
reviews.text: Has no depth data on one of the most popular lakes in the country

reviews.title: No free version
reviews.text: Pay to use only app. Makes you create an account then can’t use the app without providing payment details for a brief trial period.

reviews.title: Useless for Key West
reviews.text: Had zero clue how to get to Jewfish Basin

reviews.title: Locked behind a paywall
reviews.text: This is a $70 a year app. Total waste of money and completely misleading. Not free at all.

reviews.title: Not Free!
reviews.text: They make you to enter all your info thinking that you’re getting a free app (& maybe pay for some features) but then they tell you that it costs $70 a year! (With a 14-day free trial). The problem is most apps like this will charge you the moment you say “yes” to free trial and cancelling it is a headache!

reviews.title: Trop chère
reviews.text: To much money

reviews.title: Routing need a LOT of work
reviews.text: The maps are nice but the routes take you through land, marinas, and dangerous areas. Not quite up to spec yet. Has potential though.

reviews.title: Price?
reviews.text: Says in app purchases until you download it. Then it’s a free 3 day trial before you are billed. Never indicated how much it costs. Not playing that game.

reviews.title: Rubbish - doesn’t work
reviews.text: I gave it two weeks and tried from different locations on the water. It simply doesn’t work. I want my money back.

reviews.title: 30 Days Trials Turns 69.99 Payment
reviews.text: A friend of mine who subscribe to the yearly app sent me a link to use the extended 30 days trial as I didn’t really use that 14 days when I have the app installed. Instead of granting me the 30 days as I click on the 30 days trial button, it freaking charge me a yearly subscription.
